params.prompt: Recompose this square game key art into a wide 16:9 landscape cover banner for a game portfolio. Keep the exact same game logo lettering, spelling, colors and style, the same characters and the same art style, lighting and palette. Extend the scene naturally to the left and right so it fills the wide frame - no letterboxing, no borders, no extra text, no watermark. Place the logo clearly readable and fully inside the frame with comfortable margins, with the hero subject beside it. Scene: Tug of War - a festive village arena with red and blue banners and a cheering crowd, the bubbly 'TUG OF WAR' logo wrapped in rope with the 'KAMBA ADEEMA' ribbon, chibi villager teams in red and blue sarongs and headbands pulling one rope with the red marker in the middle, dust flying.
